title: CR60019: Cryogenic Air Separation Process
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definition of Air Separation, Specification and Application of Constituents of
Air, Introduction to Cryogenic Air Separation, Properties of Cryogenic Fluids,
Mechanical and Thermal Properties of Materials at Cryogenic Temperatures, Linde
and Clude Cycles of Liquefaction and their Derivatives, Theory of Cryogenic
Distillation, Linde Single Column, Linde Double Column, Argon Separating
Columns, Different Types of Air Separation Plants, Plants Producing Gaseous
Products, Plants Producing Liquid Products, Mass and Energy Balance in a
Cryogenic Air Separation Plants, Effects of changes of linlet Conditions on
Plant Performance. Effects of Malfunctioning of Cooling Tower, Water Pumps,
Compressor, Intercooler and Aftercooler, Refrigeration Systems, CO2 and
Moisture removal systems, Expansion Devices, Cryogenic Pumps, Insulation,
Storage Transfer and Transport Systems of Overall Plant Performance. Case
studies, Safety in Air Separation Plants.
